Coming from the French luxury audio brand, Devialet Mania is the company's first portable smart speaker with a unique 360-degree surround sound architecture. The appearance of the speaker resembles a luxurious futuristic architectural sphere with a delicate woven handle.

Own technology ASC (Active Stereo Calibration) automatically uses 4 internal microphones to scan the surrounding room space in real time, thereby automatically configuring the appropriate sound stream: When placed in the corner of the wall, the speaker will automatically increase bass, when placed in the middle of the room, the speaker will automatically expand 360-degree stereo sound. Devialet's bass power is always a fear for its competitors thanks to its symmetrical Push-Push woofer structure.
